# Forex: WebSocket API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-26 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

4 WebSocket endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Aggregates (Per Minute)

`CA.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/forex` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/forex/aggregates-per-minute.md)

Stream minute-by-minute aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified Forex currency pair via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a forex pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all forex pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple forex pairs. You can retrieve active forex tickers from our Forex Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev pair o c h l v s e`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Aggregates (Per Second)

`CAS.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/forex` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/forex/aggregates-per-second.md)

Stream second-by-second aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified Forex currency pair via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a forex pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all forex pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple forex pairs. You can retrieve active forex tickers from our Forex Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev pair o c h l v s e`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time

### Fair Market Value

`FMV.<ticker>` · Business `wss://business.massive.com/forex` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/forex/fair-market-value.md)

Stream real-time Fair Market Value (FMV) data for a specified Forex currency pair via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a forex pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all forex pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple forex pairs. You can retrieve active forex tickers from our Forex Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev fmv sym t`
- **Plan:** Business plans only (Currencies Business) · recency Real-time

### Quotes

`C.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/forex` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/forex/quotes.md)

Stream real-time Best Bid and Offer (BBO) quote data for specified Forex currency pairs via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a forex pair in the format {from}-{to} or use * to subscribe to all forex pairs. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple forex pairs. You can retrieve active forex tickers from our Forex Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev p x a b t`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter Real-time
